description: RAG-0 baseline (ADR-0123 D5): the contamination findings of the selector prompt examples against the D12 gold corpora as of the commit that added it. Ratchet: a new finding fails the test, a finding that no longer occurs must be deleted, so the list can only shrink. Regenerate with `pnpm rag0:regen` after a prompt or gold change and REVIEW the diff: new entries are written with reason UNREVIEWED and the test fails until each has a real reason.
